changes: Search results now expose source intervals, review status, evidence IDs and frame anchors; selection shares the interval with review, inspector and playlist while stale requests are ignored.
Source-linked playlist notes persist through corrections and remain visible after reload and undo.
Video-backed saved intervals can render exact MP4 clips on demand; real variable-timestamp marker tests cover a nonzero start and exclusive end.
The match export includes corrections and current match annotations; the UI downloads and reopens an unchanged package from the retained source.
Paged search hits seek by source frame and restore the interval range after page loading.
W02 adds a CPU-only mask contract, valid RLE codec, bounded rectangle stub, source/model/request identity and content-addressed save/reopen.
Paged search review ranges use source frame IDs after page loading, matching timeline and playlist semantics.
The sidecar CLI test now derives its expected default root from Python's configured temporary directory, allowing the required verifier to use isolated tmpfs storage.
W06 pre-dispatch preparation rechecks source generation and live report policy before calling a paid adapter; a stale unused reservation is recorded as confirmed no-charge.

W06 adds a bounded PNG source-frame image reference and resolver that checks match/generation/source/frame PTS, crop transform, pixel/byte limits, complete server-approved metadata and content digest before reading image bytes. Structured FrameData samples are explicitly described as non-image observations in the report prompt.

W06 admits bounded PNGs from decoded retained-source frames, stores a four-image content-addressed manifest, and binds validated image references to the current report evidence digest; ordinary report calls retain their existing signature.

W06 adds a local match route for bounded source-image selection. FFprobe verifies the selected frame ordinal and PTS, FFmpeg seeks to that PTS, and the returned pixels, source hash and current generation are checked before a manifest digest is returned.

W06 adds an offline single-request Astra Responses payload builder with approved PNG image parts, strict report schema, fixed default tier/low reasoning/no tools, and a conservative image/text/output maximum-cost envelope tied to the request digest. No transport was enabled.

W06 rejects a visual evidence request under the existing text/output-only synthetic spend policy before reservation or dispatch; real-media regression reproduced the unsafe admission before the shared gateway fix.
W06 parses one completed Astra Responses JSON draft offline, rejects tool/refusal/incomplete output, malformed or duplicate JSON, missing usage and token counts beyond the request envelope.

W06 binds the exact approved source PNG data URL and canonical request SHA-256 through the existing gateway reservation to a mocked Astra adapter; replay preserves one adapter call. An injected offline spend policy is required, and production settings do not configure it.

W06 adds a transport-injected execution boundary that rechecks the canonical request digest before submission and parses only a bounded response. Its fixed HTTPS Responses transport sends canonical JSON, refuses redirects, caps streamed bytes and elapsed time, and was tested only with a mocked HTTP client; production dispatch remains unwired.

W03 adds CPU-only preflight for a future sealed SAM shadow window. It checks current match/generation, explicit remote rights, server-owned source and checkpoint hashes, approved model/worker/crop identities, exact base frame PTS and tracking digest, deadline/cancellation, and match-scoped reusable job identity. It allocates no worker and loads no SAM/Torch.

W07 makes unsupported natural-language terms unanswerable instead of silently executing a broader event fragment; bounded player-track, review, period and time filters share the typed Python executor, and the search UI displays the interpreted filter, missing-event state and scope-safe results. Calibrated pitch region remains unsupported without event coordinates.

W07 adds an offline model-proposal validator that requires exact match/generation scope and allows only supported TypedQuery predicates before using the existing Python executor. It does not invoke or connect a model.

W07 now stores source-hash/frame-PTS-bound visual event candidates in the existing correction log and generation replay, retains declared model/version/frame evidence, presents unreviewed candidates in search and the evidence inspector, and routes accept/reject through existing correction/undo. Unreviewed or rejected model candidates are excluded from metric inputs; stale source replay marks them orphaned.

W06 now selects a guarded Astra adapter only with an explicit spend policy and two cloud opt-ins. It uses the existing gateway reservation, exact request digest, strict parser and optional fixed HTTPS transport, delegates local fallback, and keeps billing unsettled without a real provider invoice. Production settings require an explicit key, model allowlist, budget and conservative token prices.

W08 links current scoped report observation and metric references to the shared source interval selection, seeks exact event/frame evidence, and displays claim interval and availability beside the claim. Historical, metric-only and legacy prose references remain noninteractive; no new dashboard was added.

W08 now loads a cited frame outside the current page through the existing generation-scoped frame API, checks the exact frame and workspace epoch before selection, and exposes unavailable evidence without leaving a prior passage selected.

W08 now preserves server-owned eligible/requested seconds, denominator and reason codes on validated metric claims and shows claim-specific coverage beside values; missing coverage is unavailable. The report store validates the added fields. A verifier-only Git archive SIGPIPE flake was reproduced with a real large archive and fixed by draining successful archive streams before checking exit status.

W08 labels report focus entries and key contributors as tracks with unverified identity, and distinguishes a jersey candidate from a known person in the existing player detail panel. No identity assignment was changed.

W07 rejects client-authored model event proposals unless a completed server-owned provider result matches the current match, source, generation, model and exact proposal; the provider request ID survives review and rebuild. Legacy unreceipted model events cannot enter accepted views, metric inputs or provider evidence.

W03 CPU shadow preflight now verifies the retained video stream dimensions and exact FFprobe source-frame PTS against frozen tracking, then rechecks the source hash. Only full-frame geometry is admitted until a sealed crop manifest exists; no SAM runtime is loaded.

W07/W08 evidence inspector disables acceptance of legacy model proposals with no provider request while retaining rejection; a scoped proposal still reaches review, and its stale action disappears when the applied generation loads.

W07 supports left, middle and right pitch thirds through the existing typed query executor and natural-language parser. Source-frame actor coordinates count only with accepted measured calibration and eligible frame geometry; unresolved event locations produce an explicit unknown count and partial or insufficient coverage in search. No new event coordinate schema or spatial index was added.

W03 CPU preflight rechecks regular-file source and checkpoint content, current generation and live remote rights after media probing, and rejects an expired elapsed preflight deadline. Generated-video tests reproduced stale checkpoint admission before the fix and cover rights and generation changes during probing. This is still admission validation, not a sealed SAM job or real inference.

W07 match query API accepts an explicit-generation typed filter validated by the existing proposal whitelist, then executes it through the same stored-event and generation-snapshot path as natural search. Typed and natural turnover queries return the same event IDs; SQL fields, mixed query forms and stale generations are rejected. Ruling: W03's fixed processor result contract needs an end-to-end worker/download/import variant before any SAM artifact can enter it; a disconnected generic importer would bypass existing trust checks, so this independent W07 slice proceeded first.

W07 search panel exposes native event, team, pitch-third and review-status controls that submit the validated typedQuery with the active match/generation. The panel displays the interpreted filter and reuses existing scope-safe results. App tests now select match controls by accessible name so the additional native filters do not change their target. No provider call.

W03 CPU preflight now accepts a live cancellation callback and rechecks it after each blocking media probe and before admission; a generated-video regression proved the previous boolean-only check could not observe cancellation during probing. No SAM job or model execution was added. Ruling: holding the publication lock through the entire W06 provider adapter call prevents existing in-flight rights/generation changes and conflicts with stale-publication tests; the attempted lock change was fully reverted. A narrower transport-start admission boundary is needed.

W03 adds a schema-3 shadow result envelope with a fixed mask artifact path and size cap. It binds the match/generation, request/source/checkpoint digests and recomputed job identity to sealed input file entries. Daytona downloads only declared mask/progress files, verifies content and completion, rejects tampering, and cleans failed staging. Processor schema 1/2 remains separate. This is CPU transport validation; the existing Daytona input preflight still rejects the two new shadow inputs and no worker produces or imports real masks yet.

W03 Daytona input preflight now permits exactly two fixed shadow-only files beside the exact release artifact set: a sealed checkpoint and segmentation request. A shared validator verifies explicit remote permission, exact admission fields, finite deadline, match-scoped identity and input digests before upload or result acceptance. Signed fixture tests reject revoked permission, injected artifact URL and extra runtime file. No production shadow job is dispatched.

W03's shared JobRunner now rejects non-processor output schemas before selecting either local or Daytona processor dispatch. A shadow-schema ledger regression reproduced accidental processor dispatch on both settings before the guard. This is a fail-closed job-kind boundary, not shadow admission or inference.

W06 moves the final live generation/policy check, replay check and provider dispatch claim under one publication guard, while match config writes use the exclusive counterpart. A concurrency test reproduced a policy write committing between the check and claim before the fix; after the fix it waits for claim. In-flight changes still invalidate publication without erasing incurred liability.

W03 applies the same processor-schema guard at the direct local and remote worker entry points before either processes a match. A direct-invocation regression failed for both paths before the fix and passes now. Three older worker mocks were updated to supply the existing admitted processor schema after the first full backend run exposed their missing request. No SAM dispatch was enabled.

W03 Daytona preflight now parses the fixed sealed segmentation request before sandbox allocation, enforcing canonical bytes, bounded W02 schema, source/checkpoint digests and SAM alias/mode/precision. A fully resealed arbitrary payload was admitted before the fix; wrong source, checkpoint, frame cap and injected URL are rejected. A CPU worker-side loader rechecks every transferred file and the request before future model loading. No SAM runtime or paid execution was enabled.
